at-risk population,health_impact,medical_condition_patient_population,myopia prevalence,patient population,prevention
The entities "儿童青少年" (children and adolescents) and "近视" (myopia) are closely linked, as儿童青少年 represent a key patient population significantly affected by 近视. This condition is particularly common within this demographic, making it a significant public health concern. The widespread prevalence of 近视 among儿童青少年 highlights the urgent need for targeted prevention and control efforts. Therefore, when developing strategies to address this issue, special attention must be given to this age group, as the relationship between the high incidence of 近视 and儿童青少年 is strong and critical to public health initiatives.<SEP>近视is a prevalent condition primarily affecting the儿童青少年population, making them the focus of prevention strategies.<SEP>近视是儿童青少年中常见的视力问题，影响这一人群的视觉健康。
